Built `build-output/ProjectCards.jsx` and `build-output/ProjectCards.module.css`. Not run, rendered or linted yet.

**Component:** `<ProjectCards projects={[...]} loading={bool} />`. Each project is `{ id, title, client, status, owner: { name, avatar? } }`. It renders at most six cards.

**Parts reused from the design system:**
- **Card:** flat variant, as a list item.
- **Thumbnail:** `PlusThumbnail`, seeded by `id`, so each card always draws the same art.
- **Status:** `StatusPill`. In progress maps to the progress tone, Shipped to success, On hold to warning. The label is always the status word.
- **Owner:** `Avatar` at `xs` size, next to the owner's name. It falls back to initials when there is no image.
- **Loading:** six `PlusSkeleton`s in the same grid as the cards, so nothing shifts when data arrives. One visually hidden `role="status"` announces "Loading projects" for all six.

**Stylesheet:** every value is an `--sc-*` token, with no raw hex and no off-scale pixel values. The grid is one column on mobile, two from 768 px and three from 1024 px. It uses `minmax(0, 1fr)` so long titles can't widen a column.

**Open points:**
- Imports use `../src/components/...` paths and assume the build resolves them from `build-output/`.
- The 768 px and 1024 px breakpoints are literals, because I didn't find a breakpoint token. I didn't check for one beyond the spacing tokens.
- I didn't run the repo's lint or drift checks. Run `scripts/scds-component.mjs --check` and a visual pass at 390, 768 and 1024 px before Gate 2.
